turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. Was Owen heard before you entered it?
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.

I'm writing down that the zero comes off today. If it's withdrawn, what exactly is the rewrite for, Hale, and on what basis is there still a concern? Owen isn't sitting a second test because a machine had an opinion.
Here it is in writing, signed.
I'll read every line before this leaves your desk. A signature doesn't answer me, Hale. What else do you have besides the checker?
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.
We're not done, Hale. Either there's a dated document behind this rewrite, or the zero comes off with no rewrite at all. If you won't say which, I'm going to the principal's office next.
Then I'm in the principal's office at 4:30. The zero comes off today, and there is no rewrite unless you show me something with a date on it. I'll want your answer before then.
